# Protected forms: names typed with a capital mid-sentence and contractions
# typed with their apostrophe, after words that make a common word more
# likely ("I told Jim" against "him", "I feel we'll" against "well").
# Written for Sayso's replay gate; not taken from any corpus.
I told Jim about the party.
I saw Jim at the station.
Please ask Jim to call me.
I told Kim the good news.
I saw Kim near the river.
I told Tim the truth.
Ask Tim if he can drive.
I would ask Mike first.
I feel Mike was right about that.
Do you think Mike will come?
I gave Will the keys.
I met Mark after lunch.
I think Max is asleep.
We can ask Don tomorrow.
Let Jack decide this time.
I sent Grace a letter.
Say hello to Kim for me.
Did Tim enjoy the film?
I miss Mike a lot.
I feel we'll be fine.
I really think we'll win.
I hope we'll meet again.
I feel we'll need more time.
Honestly I feel we'll lose this one.
I think she'll call later.
He says he'll be late.
I know we're close now.
I think I'll stay home.
Maybe we'd better go.
I guess it's over now.
I bet she'd agree with you.
I knew he'd come back.
They said they'll help us.
I really feel we'll make it.
Tell Rose I'm sorry.
I asked Hope for help.
